name: oxbridgeai
description: TMUA and ESAT practice questions from OxbridgeAI, marked with worked solutions.

interface.longDescription: Practise for the TMUA and ESAT university admissions tests inside ChatGPT. Ask for a question by paper, part, topic or difficulty and get an original, audited multiple-choice question from a bank of over 7,500. Answer it, and the plugin marks your letter and shows the full worked solution. TMUA questions come with hints. Describe a timed paper and it tells you whether pacing, guessing or a skill is costing you marks, with a skip rule and a 7-day plan. It needs no sign-in and never sees your name, email or ChatGPT account.
defaultPrompt: Give me a TMUA Paper 2 logic question
Quiz me on ESAT physics, mechanics
Give me a hard ESAT Maths 2 integration question

positive.description: Draw a TMUA question on a topic
positive.prompt: Give me a TMUA practice question on necessary and sufficient conditions
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the question stem and options A to H with a suggested time of 3 min 45 s. It does not reveal the answer.

positive.description: Mark an answer (run straight after the previous case, in the same chat)
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether B is right or wrong, names the correct letter and shows the worked solution.

positive.description: Hint for a TMUA question (run after a TMUA question has been shown)
positive.prompt: I'm stuck, can I have a hint?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the stored hint for the question without giving away the answer.

positive.prompt: Give me an ESAT chemistry question
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an ESAT Chemistry question with options and a suggested time of 1 min 29 s, with no answer.

positive.prompt: TMUA mock: 20 questions, attempted 14, 9 right, 3 guesses, 75 minutes, I kept running out of time
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the main bottleneck, a skip rule and a 7-day plan based on the numbers given.

negative.prompt: Help me write my Oxford personal statement

negative.description: Missing numbers for the timing diagnostic
negative.prompt: My TMUA mock went badly, I ran out of time

negative.description: Marking with no question from this plugin in the chat

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It has no sign-in.

publication.release_notes: First release: TMUA and ESAT practice questions, answer marking with worked solutions, TMUA hints, and a timing diagnostic.
